T0570.title: Prompt Injection
T0570.definition: An attack that places instructions in user input or external content to override intended model behavior.
T0570.description: Prompt injection places instructions in user input, web pages, documents, or retrieved content to make a model ignore intended constraints, leak data, or perform unintended actions. Defenses cannot rely only on prompting; they need tool-permission isolation, source labeling, output validation, and human approval for high-risk actions.
T0570.usageExample: Assess Prompt Injection related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
